_comment: Sign-off smoke test for shared Metabase report cards. After editing ANY card, run: node scripts/verify-report-live.js --manifest scripts/report-cards.manifest.json — every entry must return live, non-empty results or the edit is NOT signed off. Test the heaviest org for each card (biggest = worst case for timeouts). Add a card+org row here whenever a new shared card or large org is onboarded. org_ids come from the ORGS map in server.js; card UUIDs are the public UUIDs (SHARED_UUIDS / per-org mbUuid). TIMEOUTS: the default 60s is a tripwire, but the APP's real budget is 60s then a 120s retry (see FIRST_TIMEOUT/RETRY_TIMEOUT in server.js), so a card between those two still serves live data. Rows carrying an explicit timeout of 120 are pinned to the app's true ceiling, with the measurement in the label — a failure there means the card has passed what the app itself can survive, not that it was slow once. Do NOT raise a timeout without recording the measured number and the date.

checks.label: checkins / apex (biggest — 22,880 rows for Aug 1-23 in 22.3s, measured 2026-08-24 right after the User ID column was added; here so a lost column or a re-Texted date tag is caught rather than discovered by a blank Check-Ins tab)

fasttrack / apex (biggest — worst case; measured 78s on a quiet network 2026-08-21, so 60s cries wolf. The app absorbs it: 60s first try, 120s retry. If THIS fails, the card has passed what the app itself can survive)
fasttrack / westsacramento
fasttrack / theranch

fasttrack / smyrna (TIMEZONE regression case — Eastern org. v17 computes the schedule columns in the section's own timezone; before it, Smyrna's 5pm concert was emitted as 02:00pm in Metabase's Pacific report timezone. A Pacific org cannot catch that regression, so an Eastern one is pinned here. Measured 9.0s / 10,629 rows 2026-08-24)
instructor-payout / san-francisco-rec-park (heaviest — 60+ instructor lessons marketplace)
instructor-payout / douglas-county-nv (drop-in booking regression check)
gl / apex (heaviest GL feed — worst case for the check-number CTE)
gl / littleton (treasurer turnover + check numbers)
facility / apex (heaviest rental schedule — worst case)
facility / smyrna (weekly rental schedule + Paid? column)
facility-permits / watertown (largest permit list — 1,412 issued)
facility-permits / douglas-county-nv (campsite stays — permits issued 2026-08-21)
facilities-summary / apex (heaviest — the Summary tab's own card, which had NO manifest row until 2026-08-23; measured 74.8s live that day, above the app's 60s first try and inside its 120s retry)
facilities-summary / douglas-county-nv (campsite + invoice_v2 KPI regression: 206 rows / 198 live / 41 sites / $2,900 for Aug 2026; measured 15.5s 2026-08-23)

ice-calendar / apex (per-org card 18052 — the `class` model was dropped 2026-08-22 and this card 400'd for days with nothing catching it; measured 60.5s with the date filter, so pinned to the app's 120s ceiling)
schema-catalog (card 20263 — the breaking-drift watchdog's own card; parameterless, org-independent, measured ~1s. If THIS goes dark the watchdog goes quiet without saying so)

program-checkins / watertown (the Absent column shipped 2026-08-26; watertown is the org with real absence data — 40 surviving marks over 32 people on live sections, so a lost column or a re-Texted date tag fails here rather than showing an empty Absent column on the Programs Check-Ins band)

memberships / clarksville (heaviest — 25,971 rows in 3.9s, measured 2026-08-29 right after card 17301 v2 added Coverage / Plan Season End / Plan Term Days / Auto Renew / Period Start; here so a lost column or a re-Texted date tag is caught rather than discovered as a blank Memberships report — this card had NO manifest row before)

memberships / norman (v2 COLUMN regression case — clarksville has zero subscriptions and zero term plans, so it structurally cannot catch a dropped Auto Renew or Period Start. Norman carries 404 subscriptions and 2,859 season-plan memberships, so the new columns are exercised here or nowhere)

programs / apex (heaviest programs feed. ADDED 2026-08-31 with card 17295 v6, which appends location + instructor: this shared card had NO manifest row at all, so a dropped column or a date tag reset to Text would have been discovered as a blank Programs tab. TWO THINGS ARE DELIBERATE HERE. (1) It sends a WINDOW, because this is the only card in this manifest that uses {{start_date}} OUTSIDE an optional block - Metabase enforces it and the card 400s with 'missing required parameters' however healthy it is, which is the same permanent false alarm the daily health check had against _shared/programs. (2) The window is SEVEN DAYS, the one the page itself requests on load, and not a wider 'worst case': this card scales badly with the range - measured at apex 2026-08-31, 7d 1,042 rows in 57.8s, 14d 81.5s, 30d 104.5s, 90d TIMED OUT past 150s. A row that always fails proves nothing and poisons the whole sweep, so this mirrors production load rather than inventing more. The slowness is PRE-EXISTING, not v6's: the two new CTEs cost 0.88s at apex, measured in isolation)
users / norman (Community Intel. ADDED 2026-08-31 with the residency fix to card 17689 — its Residency? column reads the same res_group CTE as the facility cards, and nothing was watching this card)
